meta.parties: Punchi Banda v. Perera Et Al

rules.statement: A fraudulent deed is not annulled by an action such as a Paulian action, but it is only declared void so far as necessary to make the property available for execution.
rules.supporting_quote: "A fraudulent deed is not annulled by that action, but it is only declared void so far as it is necessary to make the property available for execution."
